description: This Java test class 'WebModuleActivatorTest' contains unit tests for module lifecycle events such as refreshing, starting, stopping, and upgrading modules within the OpenMRS web application, specifically verifying correct invocation of lifecycle hooks and module states during these operations.

classes.name: WebModuleActivatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseModuleActivatorTest, testing module lifecycle behaviors such as refresh, start, stop, load, upgrade, and their effects on module states and context refreshes within the OpenMRS web environment.

methods.name: createWebInfFolderIfNotExist
methods.description: Creates the WEB-INF directory under 'target/test-classes' if it does not already exist, ensuring required resources for tests.

methods.name: shouldCallWillRefreshContextAndContextRefreshedOnRefresh
methods.description: Tests that the application context refresh mechanism triggers the appropriate lifecycle methods for all modules.

methods.name: shouldRefreshOtherModulesOnStoppingModule
methods.description: Verifies that stopping a module invokes refresh-related lifecycle methods on remaining modules.

methods.name: shouldRefreshOtherModulesOnStartingStoppedModule
methods.description: Ensures that starting a previously stopped module triggers refresh of all modules and appropriate start callbacks.

methods.name: shouldRefreshContextForAllStartedModulesOnWebStartup
methods.description: Checks that on web application startup, all started modules undergo context refresh, start, and lifecycle callback invocations.

methods.name: shouldRefreshOtherModulesOnInstallingNewModule
methods.description: Confirms that installing a new module causes all existing modules to refresh context, with lifecycle hooks called for the new module.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeModule
methods.description: Tests the module upgrade process by changing the module's download URL, stopping it, upgrading, and verifying version change.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeModuleWithDependents
methods.description: Verifies that upgrading a module with dependent modules causes proper stop, upgrade, and restart sequences.

methods.name: initializeInDatabase
methods.description: Sets up in-memory database and authenticates before each test.

methods.name: removeCurrentTransactionContext
methods.description: Removes current transaction context via reflection, cleanup after each test.
